context: Ongoing: FOC rewrite with a thermal model and derating for DVT actuators. This week: Compromise: derate ramps over 2 s and publishes a warning to the controller.
Ongoing: Backlash in the rev B cycloidal reducer and whether to shim or re-grind. This week: Tomas measures pin diameters: two batches differ by 8 microns; suspects pin supplier mix.
Ongoing: Running the knee at 40 C ambient for DVT; chamber access and feedthrough. This week: Dmitri: chamber only free Mondays; battery team has it midweek.
Ongoing: What to show investors when no full humanoid exists. This week: Demo done; Helena asks for a full lower body by Q1.
Ongoing: Harness conductors breaking at the knee after ~15k flex cycles
Ongoing: Spend running ahead of plan; push to stop default expedites. This week: Ingrid backs it but exempts the investor demo and DVT builds.
Ongoing: Too many life tests for one grip fixture and one dyno. This week: Night runs work but nobody watches them; one overnight run lost to a loose clamp.
Ongoing: Whether to machine pelvis plates from 7075 or wait for a casting
